name: VALUE Capacity Expansion Model v1

decision_stages.typed_rule: one decision per stable investment owner/technology/region; ROI above preferred rate; otherwise payback at or below target; negative net revenue retires; otherwise no action
decision_stages.remaining_difference: typed path groups physical asset income by stable owner and does not yet reproduce every retained policy-support income allocation

decision_stages.typed_rule: manifest-selected typed headroom policies applied once as technology-year MW budgets; an explicit eligibility catalogue governs uncapped and site-constrained technologies
decision_stages.retained_rule: annual trace-derived cap functions inside the retained loop
decision_stages.remaining_difference: typed evidence and retained intermediate arrays are not yet identical

decision_stages.typed_rule: normalized non-terminal project inventory retained for audit
decision_stages.retained_rule: status, schedule, uncertainty and zombie filters before admission
decision_stages.remaining_difference: Prompt 43 does not claim retained zombie-filter parity

decision_stages.retained_rule: regional/technology success probability with retained pipeline timing
decision_stages.remaining_difference: record-level retained random and timing traces are not identical

decision_stages.typed_rule: project assets preserved; live PSM capacity aggregated to technology/region-compatible market agents
decision_stages.retained_rule: location and proportional allocation into pre-existing aggregate agents
decision_stages.remaining_difference: asset lineage is new and aggregate allocation is deterministic but not a retained numerical replay

decision_stages.typed_rule: versioned project-to-asset record; next-year physical and cost coupling; proportional retirement economics
decision_stages.retained_rule: mutates aggregate Python market objects and their capital_cost fields
decision_stages.remaining_difference: typed immutable state replaces retained object mutation

decision_stages.typed_rule: initial pumped-hydro stock is exogenous; no additional default reservoir project schedule
decision_stages.retained_rule: retained loop contains scenario-specific exogenous pumped-hydro capacity updates
decision_stages.remaining_difference: future pumped-hydro projects require an explicit hydrology/planning data module

publication_rule: Results may be called VALUE CEM v1 results. They must not be called an exact doctoral-reproduction result.
